title: .activeloom-herd.json
description: Per-repository configuration for the herdr orchestration skills. Read from the integration branch at the remote, never from a pull request head. Every section is optional; an absent section means disabled or the conservative default. Commands are argv arrays, never shell strings.

integration_branch.description: Branch converged work ships to. Default: the remote's default branch.

bootstrap.description: Run in a new worktree before any session starts. Default: none.

gate_fix.description: Present: the herder may open a test/tooling-only fix PR for a red gate the PR under review did not cause. Absent: a red gate is a block.

product_globs.description: Product code a gate fix must never touch.

tooling_globs.description: Scripts a gate fix may change.

test_globs.description: Tests, fixtures and harnesses a gate fix may change.

off_limits_globs.description: Paths a gate fix must never touch; wins over every other class.

extra_checks.description: Run in the PR worktree after merging a gate fix, before re-running the pass.

auto.description: Route glance-sized PRs to auto-glance under horch. Default false: horch alerts the user instead.

ship.description: Present: horch ships converged work to the integration branch. Absent: horch alerts that the PR is ready and merges nothing.

on_ship.description: What happens to linked open issues after the merge.

label.description: Label added to linked issues; required when on_ship is label.

checks.description: required: the branch's required checks must pass and must not be empty. all-runs: additionally every workflow run at the head completed green.

post_ship_checks.description: Run in the primary checkout after a ship.

engines.description: Engines horch may start builds on. Default: the orchestrator's own engine.
Grill chain order. Default: claude, codex, gemini.

verify_first_label.description: Removed after a chain, which counts as the verification it asked for.

persona.description: One line describing the issue owner the driver answers as.

production_lanes.description: Token-heavy production work horch may hand to a named engine and skill.

brief.description: Repository-relative document the lane reads first.

promotion.description: Present: hpromote may run. Absent: hpromote refuses.
